sources.name: Edmonton Local Immigration Partnership (ELIP)
sources.notes: The Events Calendar (WordPress) - confirmed live 2026-08-26. Community-wide settlement/newcomer events calendar (disability benefits info sessions, YMCA Bridge to Work intakes, Community Collaboration Table) aggregated from many Edmonton settlement orgs - the single best-fit practical source found for this city.

sources.name: Africa Centre
sources.notes: The Events Calendar (WordPress) - confirmed live 2026-08-26. Cultural/community hub with a mix of cultural events and settlement-adjacent programming (e.g. Black Entrepreneurship info sessions); filed as social since its primary identity is community/cultural connection, but expect some practical-flavoured events to land here too.

sources.name: Edmonton Mennonite Centre for Newcomers (EMCN)
sources.notes: Largest newcomer-serving agency in Edmonton (17,000+ newcomers/year, 5 locations) - the natural anchor practical source, same role as Centre for Newcomers in Calgary. But the domain (emcn.ab.ca) TIMED OUT on every request attempted 2026-08-26 (TLS connect timeout, not a 403/404) - looks like it actively blocks non-browser/automated clients rather than just missing a feed. Worth a retry with a real browser session or a different network path before writing it off.

sources.name: University of Alberta - International Student + Visitor Services
sources.notes: U of A's main site runs on Sitecore behind Akamai and 403s a plain UA (needed full Chrome UA + Accept header to even load the HTML) - confirmed 2026-08-26. No wp-json/tribe/sqs feed (it's not WordPress/Squarespace); the one plausible-looking 'calendar.ualberta.ca' link on the events page turned out to be Acalog (the academic course catalog), a false lead - not an events system at all. Registration for ISVS events goes through marketplace.ualberta.ca (a Shopify-like storefront, no public feed either). Single best-fit source for this city's mission but genuinely no feed found on a first pass.

sources.name: MacEwan University - International Student Welcome Sessions
sources.notes: Runs a bespoke in-house calendar (js/Calendar5.js - not a platform we recognize, no JSON/ical route found) - confirmed 2026-08-26. International Student Welcome Session dates ARE published as static text on macewan.ca/wcm/MacEwanEvents/INTERNATIONAL_STUDENT_WELCOME though, so the known Fall 2026 sessions are hand-entered in manual_events below.

sources.name: NAIT International and Intercultural Community Centre
sources.notes: ookslife.ca is Modern Campus Engage (ex-CampusLabs), NOT multi-institution - the 2026-08-26 '11,779 events / many schools' read was wrong; the vanity host scopes results to NAIT's one Engage community and the BranchId facet is just NAIT's internal campuses. Unblocked 2026-09-10 with the new campuslabs_engage parser (same-origin /api/discovery/event/search, unauthenticated). org_filter is deliberately tight - only the 'NAIT International and Intercultural Community Centre (IICC)' (~13) and 'NAIT Immigration Advisors' (~4) orgs, i.e. PGWP/study-permit/PR sessions, ISCQ workshops, late orientation, Global Cafe. Broadening it pulls in Indigenous-services (Nîsôhkamâtotân), athletics and 200+ club events. tz_offset=-6 localises Engage's UTC timestamps to Edmonton. NAIT Spiritual Well-being (23 events) is a candidate for a separate spiritual-stream source later.

sources.name: Edmonton Public Library
sources.notes: Runs BiblioCommons (epl.bibliocommons.com), same platform as Calgary Public Library - unlocked 2026-09-09 by the generic `bibliocommons` parser. Confirmed live via a direct GET to /v2/events (200 OK) before wiring in.

sources.name: MacEwan International Student Welcome Session
sources.notes: Hand-entry counterpart to the macewan-studentlife probe source above (whose Calendar5.js platform has no feed) - the Fall 2026 welcome session dates are published as static text and entered directly in manual_events.

sources.name: NAIT DestiNAITion Global
sources.notes: Hand-entry counterpart to the nait-international probe source above (whose ookslife.ca/Presence platform mixes in other institutions' events, unsafe to parse without a NAIT-specific filter) - the flagship intercultural festival date is well-publicized and entered directly in manual_events.

sources.name: Explore Edmonton - Festivals
sources.notes: City DMO festivals listing page - plain HTML (?format=json just returns the normal page, not Squarespace), no feed. Used as the source for hand-picked festival dates in manual_events below (Strathearn Art Walk & Music Festival).

sources.name: Ellerslie Road Baptist Church - ESL Ministry
sources.notes: Welcomes newcomers with spoken-English help and socializing; contact esl@erbc.ca. Standing program, no dated feed (confirmed not WordPress/tribe 2026-08-26) - left empty per the no-recurring-events rule.

sources.name: Kingdom Way Church - Free ESL Class
sources.notes: Free ESL classes via Zoom, open to anyone wanting to learn English grammar and conversation. Standing program, no dated feed - left empty per the no-recurring-events rule.

sources.name: Edmonton Newcomers Centre
sources.notes: WordPress site (confirmed 2026-08-26) but no tribe/Events-Calendar plugin active (wp-json/tribe route 404s). Free ESL classes welcoming all faiths and backgrounds, with an explicit gospel message at the end students may opt out of - filed spiritual for that faith framing, though the ESL service itself is broadly practical. No dated feed - left empty.
